scope: Whole-answer Train span supervision fix and a paired frozen-encoder pointer study; no current accuracy improvement or new selected model is claimed.

top5Audit.definition: Membership in the actual saved topk indices, resolving any ties by the executed topk result; optimistic strict-score rank is not used.

preliminaryTargetAudit.scope: Rejected strict punctuation-matching diagnostic, not the adopted adapter and never used in model fitting. Preserved with its exact source and raw records.

study.scope: Only two span pointers are fitted. Parent encoder/fusion/other heads are frozen. Internal Train families may have been seen by the parent: this is a head-selection split, not independent generalization evidence. Original scalar answer scoring is unchanged.

plan.scope: Paired loss-target correction with fixed encoder, fusion, GRU and all other heads. Same initial two span pointers, 8 epochs and exact batches for each of three seeds. Only existing TAT-QA Train span annotations carry pointer loss; full benchmark denominators do not change.
plan.selection: Within original Train source families: highest held scalar answerExact, then lower corrected span NLL; include untouched parent as epoch 0. The parent saw these Train families before, so this is not independent-source generalization.
plan.nextGate: Require every corrected seed to improve the internal Train answer score over parent and be no worse than its matched legacy arm before refitting. Refit for the selected epoch budget using all Train span rows, then actual sequential Train preservation controls before any fixed original Dev comparison. No Test or frozen retail holdout inference.
plan.adoption: Fixed primary seed42; original public Dev answer accuracy must improve with other public task scores preserved, controlled parameter/evidence/state/type retained, and generated/retail economic losses no worse. No adoption on cached Train scores alone.

decision.decision: All corrected seeds improve parent after pointer fitting, but each is one answer below the matched old-target arm. The predeclared gate fails: no full-Train refit, Dev selection, or model replacement. The loss-target correctness fix is retained; no accuracy benefit from it is established.

studyAudit.note: Cached pointer computations are an internal head comparison. They do not replace actual sequential inference or a full public benchmark.

complementary.scope: native component diagnostics, not an end-to-end order benchmark

core-retail-train-v1.scope: Frozen complementary snapshot plus source-disjoint original Train sales; no latent demand or organizational efficacy claim

core-tatqa-train-v1.scope: Frozen complementary snapshot plus original Train financial-document annotations; no organizational efficacy claim

core-retail-holdout-v1.scope: Existing inputs unchanged plus frozen unseen-source evaluation; original public Train split reused only for previously unused sources, not model training

core-retail-linked-v1.scope: Original snapshots unchanged; extra observations within existing Train source families

source.scope: Fixed recovery-scoped v2/42 on the published forecast-v1 model; controlled Dev selection, no new Test result.

preliminaryHistoricalComparison.response: Preserved preliminary mismatch; repeated both source versions at explicitly matched 4 threads, with exact complete outputs.

derivedCache.scope: Intermediate frozen encoder features are re-derivable by the cache phase of scripts/study_span_supervision.py with the registered Train inputs, parent weights, tokenizer revision, batching and source code. Raw targets, parent predictions and all learned head predictions are included in the public archive.

limitations: The 1,163-case selection denominator contains only original Train span annotations; it is not the full public benchmark.
Parent encoder saw these Train source families before; no independent generalization claim.
All three corrected arms fail the predeclared matched-old-target score gate by one answer. No refit or new Dev evaluation follows.
Removing invalid labels does not establish an accuracy improvement. Public scalar extraction, demand calibration and protected Test criterion remain unresolved.
Original annotations, dataset hashes, source groups and scoring rules are unchanged. Unsupported multi-span/count and complex expressions are not removed from full benchmark scores.

Large intermediate encoder cache is excluded from the public archive; re-running learning requires the registered Train snapshot and parent checkpoint. Inference with the retained public model does not require those Train assets.
